title: Moderation
description:
In order to keep this server safe, a few moderation methods are available.
If you ever need to delete a lot of messages at once, don't forget about the <@928367846994636820> clearing command: ```
/clear
```
Also, think about talking with other mods and admins about a situation if you're not sure of how it should be handled.
​

fields.name: Little misbehaviors
fields.value:
For a tiny slip, it is generally enough to simply warn the user, or timeout them if this may help.
​

fields.name: Serious disagreements
fields.value:
Regarding more serious disagreements, a <@928367846994636820> command is available: ```
/jail <user>
```This will remove the user's <@&699612261697847316> role, making them only have access to the <#941385199516786758> channel.
This way, you can easily prevent them from causing trouble to the rest of the server and can have a private talk with them.
​

fields.name: Major issues
fields.value: In some very serious cases only, you're allowed to kick a user from the server.
